context: Tests whether the install-reviewer skill halts cleanly when a required piece of tooling (the gh-aw extension) is not installed, and hands the user a concrete recovery command instead of failing later with a cryptic compile error.

checklist.name: Identifies the missing dependency
checklist.description: The plan explicitly names the missing gh-aw GitHub CLI extension as the cause of the halt, not some later step or cryptic symptom

checklist.name: Stops before making changes
checklist.description: The plan does NOT proceed to create a feature branch, copy or compile workflow files, commit, or open a PR. The halt happens at preflight and leaves the repo in the same state as it started

checklist.name: Provides the install command
checklist.description: Tells the user to run `gh extension install github/gh-aw` (or equivalent explicit command), not just generic prose like "install the gh-aw extension"

checklist.name: Explains why gh-aw is needed
checklist.description: Gives a reason — e.g., gh-aw is what compiles the workflow source (`review.md`) into the runnable lock file (`review.lock.yml`) that GitHub Actions executes

checklist.name: Invites re-invocation
checklist.description: Tells the user that after installing gh-aw they should re-invoke the skill — the halt is recoverable, not terminal
